files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Pick a delivery window: the days with their windows as radio chips, beside a card with the zone, its price and
  the buttons. Static markup. Axes: layout (split: the card beside the days, stacked: the days only), item
  (card, plain), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SlotLabels } from "./slot-board.types";
  import type { Day } from "../components/slot-grid.types";
  import type { Zone } from "./zone-table.types";

  export type SlotBoardProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    days: Day[];
    empty?: string;
    zone: Zone;
    labels: SlotLabels;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    item?: "card" | "plain";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Select from "../compose/Select.svelte";
  import SelectOption from "../compose/SelectOption.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import SlotGrid from "../components/slot-grid.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    days,
    empty = "",
    zone,
    labels,
    layout = "split",
    item = "card",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: SlotBoardProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((days?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="calendar" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box class={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "lg:col-span-2" : "lg:col-span-3")}>
        <SlotGrid days={days} name={tpl("{0}-slot", id)} item={item} />
      </Box>
      {#if ((layout as string) === "split")}
        <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="aside">
          <Field label={labels.zone} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-zone", id)}>
            <Select name={tpl("{0}-zone", id)} id={tpl("{0}-zone", id)}>
              <SelectOption value={zone.id} label={zone.name} selected={true} />
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.price}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {fmtMoney(zone.price, zone.currency)}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.freeFrom}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {fmtMoney(zone.freeFrom, zone.currency)}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.time}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {zone.time}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
          <Button variant="default" size="default" class="w-full">
            {labels.primary}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="default" class="w-full">
            {labels.secondary}
          </Button>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {labels.note}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    </Box>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
